cardSummary: Explore seeded sandy shelves, rocky slopes, lit trenches and occasional wrecks east of NewWorld.
summary: Take the final vanilla boat east to find a continuous seabed, three biomes and wrecks with rare fish nearby. Returning to an unloaded stretch regenerates its initial terrain and fish from the saved seed.
controls: Take the final vanilla boat east. To choose a layout, set `seed` in the recipe before building, or edit `[World] seed` in the generated INI while the game is closed.
apis: JAMM chunk layout and streaming scripts, GameMaker instance and collision APIs, legacy Boat7, Fish and save events, and Catalog API lookup when installed.
assets: Three runtime objects, four sprites built from the local archive, and fourteen standalone scripts. The recipe guards the native fish respawn script and both SaveManager writes.
saves: The seed is the only generated-world state saved. `jamm_endless_ocean.ini` stores it under `[World]` as `seed`, shared by all slots in that save directory. Transient fish instance IDs are excluded from `[Fishes]`. Normal catches, quests and Fishalog progress still use the game's save system.
compatibility: Targets the August 2023 legacy VM archive or a compatible merged archive. Enable the recipe in a JAMM profile, or build it on top of a verified pack archive. Use JAMM with Endless Ocean generator version 2.
how: The floor joins the last collidable terrain and eases into a continuous profile over three chunks. The generator reserves the existing room dimensions and artwork before adding 488 exploration chunks of 2,048 pixels each.
Native CaveRock silhouettes, kelp, corals and lights mark sandy shelves, rocky slopes and trenches. Each floor strip has a matching slope mask and solid underlay to the room bottom.

The camera streams at most five chunks. Each can spawn one vanilla fish per depth band, with a collision check before spawning. Wrecks appear 10–20 chunks apart and attract a rare fish within the same budget.
The seed defaults to 271828 and is shared by all slots in the save directory. Primary and backup saves skip transient fish IDs.
